m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Wizard, you've returned... with <ITALICS>one </ITALICS> Kookaburra Egg? Were you too late to save the other one?
Briar wouldn't give him up? Named him Kiki? I'm so stoked to hear that! It means my words got through to him. As for the other Egg...
What kind of conduit of wisdom would I be if I didn't urge you to use the majestic little Kookaburra as an exercise in nurturing Life?
It's great to see you again, Wizard. Word on the wind is you're a master of righting wrongs. I could really use someone like that right now.
I recently took a sharp but rather thorny Initiate named Briar under my wing. He's a talented Theurgist, but lacks respect for the little things.
So I tried to illustrate the simple complexities of Life to him by using Kookaburra Eggs as an example.
But Briar mistook my attempt to inspire as me undercutting his skill. Enraged, he grabbed the Kookaburra Eggs and ran.
I fear he'll corrupt those innocent Kookaburras, but I lack the aggression to confront the bristly Briar. Will you rescue them?
Please, Wizard. Save the lives of those poor, innocent Kookaburras from the likes of the thorny Briar.
